notes.title: Crossroads goes free!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34045614/df54deb4b8e2bc3908f003c87f8098ba2cac380f.png[/img]

Hello fellow adventurers!

Crossroads is going to become free forever.
We hope that with this change more people will be able to try it out :)

Cheers,
icon.games team

notes.title: Lucky Edition is here!
notes.content:
Hello fellow adventurers!
We made a big update with new content & major balance changes. Are you ready to get lucky?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045614/fe35a3d9bd7cd23b078daa02bc2bad6228256233.png[/img]

What's new:
- New card type called "Fortune" & 10 new cards of this type.
- New card type called "Action" & 15 new cards of this type.
- Trap cards balance overhaul.
- Now it is possible to choose between two difficulty settings. Hardcore mode has arrived!
- Now it is possible to start new game from settings.
- Additional polish & bugfixing.

With this update the game is upgraded to Lucky Edition! Hope that you will like it :)

Cheers,
icon.games team

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We made an update.

New features:
- Now it is possible to see your current score during adventure run & exit it anytime to return to the tavern. 

Balance tweaks:
- Field generation is adjusted to drop less empty cards.
- Skill points reset, appearance change & religion change is free of charge now! Yay!
- Rogue hero power cooldown is reduced.

Other changes:
- Added extra note to item enchant popup.
- Ultrawide screens support.
- Every enemy now has a name!
- Contract highlight improved.

Hope that you will like it!

Cheers,
icon.games team

notes.title: Steam Cloud
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just implemented Steam Cloud saving!
We hope that some of you will find it useful :)

Thanks for playing!

Cheers,
icon.games team

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This update is dedicated to balance tweaks for the first adventure (based on the community feedback).
The goal is to make game experience smoother & reduce grinding.

Hope that you will like it.

Cheers,
icon.games team

notes.title: V-Sync update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We just pushed an update with V-Sync enabled by default.
In the future update we will add possibility to turn on / off V-Sync from settings.

Cheers,

notes.title: Meet the team
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Crossroads will be released tomorrow so it is a great moment to introduce the icon.games team members.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045614/6949dddba979cbd172edb51ba2903364f3d1ce46.jpg[/img]

We are 2 enthusiasts sharing a dream of making games that will be enjoyed by players all across the globe. And, of course, we love playing games!

Crossroads is our first big title that was in the development for the last 2 years and it was the greatest journey ever. We were working hard, being cross-functional, learning new stuff & iterating over and over to bring it to its current state.

We hope that you will like it :) And want to say big thanks for all the support and feedback! It means a lot to us.

Cheers,
Dmitry & Kate

notes.title: Gameplay #5 - Key
notes.content:

notes.title: Card preview - Spell #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045614/0fc232a02ceb19e173ac4d778e0f410c30c17397.gif[/img]

How to do without the beloved fireball? It is a basic spell that deals damage to one opponent.

notes.title: Gameplay #4 - Spells
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045614/e9ce2818451302cd451e62e5aa47fdbaab03d0f2.gif[/img]

In Crossroads you collect a deck of spells that can be used during an adventure.

This is an example of classical hex spell that turns the enemy into a helpless little animal.

notes.title: Gameplay #3 - Blocking
notes.content:

notes.title: Best wishes!
notes.content: [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045614/13c74c7bcad6ae874381697df9c0d8055060e744.png[/img]

notes.title: Card preview - Enemy #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045614/33a70e6d0eb7637b5b120a760ab32d475112ed8e.gif[/img]

Every opponent you encounter on your way has certain abilities.
You will need to find optimal approach for everyone.

Who to eliminate first? Next to whom spells should not be used? Maybe it is better to throw a fireball?

notes.title: Gameplay sneak peek #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34045614/6e0e6d9b96e6f9470f93a42c26dc68c60eacf4cb.gif[/img]

The core gameplay mechanic is pretty simple - you open cards to find your way to the next floor. And there are enemies. And traps. And events. And much more.

So, where's exit?
